title: 第98章 整人这种事，我熟啊！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 姜云娜的阴谋算不得高，无非就是利用这群女人对唐画的好感罢了。而女人，在偶像面前，很多时候都是不带脑子的。果然，听到姜云娜的话，那群世家小姐看向唐逸的目光，都变得恶心起来。“什么？唐逸竟然这么无耻吗？太可恶了。”“买的诗词？太可笑了，今日的题目可是孔诗岚亲自出的题，他想取巧？简直就是做梦！”“重点是他竟然敢陷害唐画，三元及第的状元，岂能是他陷害的？”“……”周围顿时骂声一片。当然，这其中自然有一些人看穿了姜云娜拙劣的演技，但还是选择了附和。唐画三元及第前途无量，而唐逸不过是个默默无闻的废物罢了，就算如今是锦衣卫百户，那也不过是个芝麻官罢了。和三元及第的唐画比起来算得了什么？！既然没有利用价值，那被落井下石，就是他最好的价值。“娜娜，不要这么说小逸，小逸不是故意做这些事的……”颜霜玉心头暗暗给姜云娜竖起大拇指，语气却假装带着责备。话落，她看向周围的一群女人，装得有些尴尬道：“诸位姐姐别在意，小逸这孩子母亲过世得早，缺少管教，往后我一定会好好教育。”“诸位姐姐不要因为这件事，影响到孩子的婚事。”短短两句话，顿时让现场一群女人脸色都难看下来。唐敬是吏部侍郎，唐画三元及第前途无量，唐家注定会成为京都新贵，长久不衰，将女儿嫁给唐家其他子嗣，也是不错的选择。但要是将女儿嫁给一个为达目的不择手段的无耻之徒，她们是不愿意的。可以说，颜霜玉几乎三言两语，便断了唐逸的姻缘。想要娶个名门贵女，是完全没戏了。要知道，今日能在这里的，都是各大勋贵豪族的嫡女。“……呵，那唐夫人是该好好管教管教。”一群女人随意敷衍。颜霜玉和姜云娜见到这一幕，相视一眼嘴角都勾起阴谋得逞的笑容。唐画听着周围的议论，脸上虽然依旧温文尔雅，目光却不由挑衅看了眼唐逸。好戏开场了！想要登台，那就先把眼前这关过了吧！“这……这你也能忍？”萧棣错愕看向唐逸。萧棣武功好感知强，自然听到这些女人都在骂唐逸。骂得可难听了。“狗咬你一口，你还能咬回去？”唐逸瞥了一眼对面的那群女人，脸上没有半点意外。有颜霜玉和姜云娜这两朵奇葩在，不搞点事情就不正常了。“咬回去阿！我就咬过。”萧棣抱着双手靠着柱子，脸上有追忆。唐逸听到这话震惊，我靠，真的假的？你曾经经历了什么？堂堂一个皇子居然沦落到咬狗的地步？不对，老兄，咬狗这种事很光荣吗？你竟然还一脸嘚瑟的样子？咋地，你做了别人做不到的事，很光荣啊？“牛，你牛……”唐逸竖起大拇指。这时，一道稚嫩的童声传遍全场。“你胡说，我哥哥很厉害，我哥哥才没有买诗，我哥哥都是自己写的诗。”“姜姐姐，你为什么要害我哥哥呀！”“就因为我哥哥不娶你，你就陷害他吗？可是，你明明喜欢的是唐画哥哥呀。”唐逸听到这声音，困意顿消，当场跳了起来。他猛地回头看去，果然就看到杜凌菲牵着唐音站在姜云娜面前。此时，唐音躲在姜云娜的身后，露出半颗脑袋，有些怯生生地看着姜云娜。唐逸心头流淌过一阵暖流，这妹没白疼，哪怕再胆小，有事真敢上。“现在，你还能忍？”萧棣肩膀撞了撞唐逸。“我忍个毛！”唐逸拎着绣春刀，直接向着女人那边走了过去。妹妹都宣战了，他这个当哥的能落在后面？姜云娜怎么也没想到，火都拱起来了，竟然冒出来这么个小豆丁坏事。眼看着很多人看向她的目光都诡异起来，姜云娜怒火中烧。该死的小贱人，你这时候跳出来找死啊！人还没一棵大蒜高，还想给你哥翻身？！“胡说什么？我眼瞎吗？会看上你哥？”“就他这种人，他也不撒泡尿照照自己什么德性，他配吗？”姜云娜向前走了两步，微微弯腰，眼神凶恶。唐音吓得脑袋缩回杜凌菲身后。杜凌菲揉了揉唐音的脑袋，勾起唇角：“唐四少不配？那姜姑娘要死要活的想嫁，是贱吗？”“不对，肯定点，你就是贱。”“唐四少比不上唐画？确实，一个有名无实之人，也敢和四少比？他也配？”杜凌菲声音清洌平静，却带着一股不容置疑的气势。原本看戏的一群人顿时都震惊了，唐画比不上唐逸？开什么玩笑！唐画可是陛下钦点的三元及第的状元，前途无量。唐逸呢？唐逸有什么？顶着唐家嫡子的名头，却是废物一个。远处，刘温等大臣听到这话，看向唐敬的目光都变得极为怪异，有嘲讽有戏谑，还有幸灾乐祸！“咳，唐侍郎真是治家有方啊！”刘温这段时间本来就很不爽唐敬，逮着机会就嘲讽：“这原本要对付小诗仙的沈园诗会，现在成了你们唐家的家庭大会了。”“三元及第的状元庶子，对战一无是处的废物嫡子，精彩，精彩啊！”听到这话，周围顿时响起一阵哄笑声。唐敬脸色没有太大变化，但看着唐逸的那一双眼睛，几乎能刀人了。废物，废物，老子怎么生了你这么个混账东西。这种场合，必须以唐家荣誉为重，你还处处和你大哥争，你算什么东西？你争得他吗？丢人现眼的东西。“呵，这个女人竟然说你不如唐逸，你怎么看？”舞台上，刘州扭了扭脖子，满脸阴狠。当日幻音坊的耻辱，他可是时时刻刻都记着呢。唐画淡淡扫了唐逸一眼，冷笑道：“怎么看？当然是笑着看，接下来，轮到你出场了。”“他不是很狂吗？那我们就让他连入场的资格都没有。”刘州一愣，当即明白了唐画的意思。是要让他将幻音坊的事无限放大！要让所有人觉得，唐逸就是个纨绔色鬼，连泡花魁的诗词都是买的。那孔家这样的名门望族，会选择一个声名狼藉的人当女婿吗？肯定不会啊！刘州盯着唐逸的背影，嘴角泛起冷笑，整人这种事，我熟啊！“放心吧唐哥，接下来交给我。”“我马上，就给他上一道大菜！”
content_en: Jiang Yunna's conspiracy was not high-level, it was just to take advantage of these women's good impression of Tang Hua.Women, on the other hand, are often thoughtless in front of their idols.Sure enough, after hearing Jiang Yunna's words, the ladies from the aristocratic families looked at Tang Yi and became disgusted."What? Is Tang Yi so shameless? It's so abominable." "Purchased poems? It's too ridiculous. Today's question was asked by Kong Shilan himself. He wants to take advantage of it? It's just a dream!" "The point is that he dared to frame Tang Hua. How could he be the one who framed the number one scholar in three yuan?" "..." There was a sudden curse around him.Of course, some of them saw through Jiang Yunna's poor acting skills, but they still chose to agree.Tang Hua's Sanyuan Jidi has a bright future, but Tang Yi is just an unknown waste. Even if he is now a member of the Jin Yiwei Hundreds, he is just a sesame official.What does it mean compared to Sanyuan Jidi's Tang paintings?!Since he has no use value, being beaten into trouble is his best value."Nana, don't talk about Xiaoyi like that. Xiaoyi didn't do these things on purpose..." Yan Shuangyu secretly gave Jiang Yunna a thumbs up, but her tone was pretending to be reproachful.After saying this, she looked at the group of women around her, pretending to be a little embarrassed and said, "Sisters, don't worry. Xiaoyi's mother passed away early and lacked discipline. I will definitely educate her well in the future." "Sisters, please don't let this incident affect the child's marriage." In just two words, the faces of the women present suddenly turned ugly.Tang Jing is the Minister of the Ministry of Civil Affairs, and the Tang Dynasty Painting Sanyuan has a bright future. The Tang family is destined to become a new noble in Kyoto and will last for a long time. Marrying his daughter to other descendants of the Tang family is also a good choice.But they are not willing to marry their daughter to a shameless man who will do whatever it takes to achieve his goals.It can be said that Yan Shuangyu ended Tang Yi's marriage with just a few words.It is completely out of the question to marry a noble girl.You know, those who can be here today are all the legitimate daughters of major noble families."...Ha, Mrs. Tang should be disciplined and disciplined." A group of women responded casually.When Yan Shuangyu and Jiang Yunna saw this scene, they looked at each other with smiles on their lips that suggested they had succeeded.Tang Hua listened to the discussions around him. Although his face was still gentle, his eyes couldn't help but look at Tang Yi provocatively.The show is about to begin!If you want to go on stage, you have to get through this first!"This... can you bear this?" Xiao Di looked at Tang Yi in astonishment.Xiao Di has good martial arts skills and strong perception, so he naturally heard these women scolding Tang Yi.The scolding was awful."If a dog bites you, can you bite it back?" Tang Yi glanced at the group of women opposite, with no surprise on his face.With these two weirdos, Yan Shuangyu and Jiang Yunna, it would be abnormal if something didn't happen."Bite it back! I've bitten it before." Xiao Di leaned against the pillar with his hands folded, with memories on his face.Tang Yi was shocked when he heard this. Holy shit, is it true?What have you experienced?A noble prince actually reduced to biting a dog?No, man, is it honorable to bite a dog?You actually look so embarrassed?Hey, you did something that others couldn't do. Isn't it an honor?"Awesome, you are awesome..." Tang Yi gave a thumbs up.At this time, a childish voice spread throughout the audience."You're talking nonsense. My brother is very powerful. He didn't buy poems. He wrote them all by himself." "Sister Jiang, why do you want to harm my brother?" "Just because my brother doesn't marry you, you frame him? But you clearly like Brother Tang Hua." When Tang Yi heard this voice, his sleepiness disappeared and he jumped up on the spot.He turned around suddenly and saw Du Lingfei holding Tang Yin standing in front of Jiang Yunna.At this time, Tang Yin hid behind Jiang Yunna, half of his head exposed, and looked at Jiang Yunna timidly.A warm current flowed through Tang Yi's heart. This girl's pain was not in vain. No matter how timid she was, she really dared to do something."Now, can you still bear it?" Xiao Di bumped into Tang Yi with his shoulder."I can't stand it!" Tang Yi walked directly towards the woman, holding the embroidered spring knife.My sister has declared war, how can he, the elder brother, be left behind?Jiang Yunna never expected that such a little kid would come out and do bad things.Seeing many people looking at her strangely, Jiang Yunna was furious.Damn little bitch, you jumped out to seek death now!You are not as tall as a garlic plant, but you still want to stand up for your brother?!"What nonsense are you talking about? Am I blind? Will I fall in love with your brother?" "For a person like him, he doesn't show his virtue by peeing in the urine. Is he worthy?" Jiang Yunna took two steps forward, bent slightly, with a fierce look in her eyes.Tang Yin was so frightened that she retracted her head behind Du Lingfei.Du Lingfei rubbed Tang Yin's head and raised the corners of her lips: "The fourth young master Tang is not worthy? Then Miss Jiang wants to marry her desperately, is that a bitch?" "No, be sure, you are cheap." "The fourth young master Tang is not as good as Tang Hua? Indeed, a person in name only dares to compete with the fourth young master? Is he worthy?" Du Lingfei's voice was clear and calm, but it carried an unquestionable aura.The group of people who were watching the show were suddenly shocked. Tang Hua couldn't compare to Tang Yi?What a joke!Tang Hua is the number one scholar in the Three Yuan Dynasty appointed by His Majesty, and has a bright future.Where is Tang Yi?What does Tang Yi have?Despite his reputation as the legitimate son of the Tang family, he is a loser.In the distance, when Liu Wen and other ministers heard this, they looked at Tang Jing with extremely strange looks, including ridicule, teasing, and gloating!"Ahem, Tang Shilang is really good at managing the family!" Liu Wen was already very unhappy with Tang Jing during this period, so he took the opportunity to mock: "This Shen Yuan Poetry Club, which was originally meant to deal with the little Shixian, has now become a family gathering of your Tang family." "The son of a concubine who has reached the number one position in three yuan, fighting against a useless legitimate son, wonderful, wonderful!" Hearing this, a burst of laughter suddenly sounded from around him.Tang Jing's expression didn't change much, but the eyes that looked at Tang Yi were almost as sharp as a knife.Waste, waste, why did I give birth to such a bastard like you?In this kind of situation, the honor of the Tang family must be the most important thing. If you still argue with your eldest brother everywhere, who do you think you are?Can you win him?Something embarrassing."Oh, this woman actually said that you are not as good as Tang Yi. What do you think?" On the stage, Liu Zhou twisted his neck with a sinister look on his face.He always remembers the humiliation of Huanyinfang that day.Tang Hua glanced at Tang Yi lightly and sneered: "What do you think? Of course you are watching with a smile. Next, it's your turn." "Isn't he crazy? Then let's let him continue.
title_en: Chapter 98 I am familiar with this kind of tricking people!
